_comment: WRITING TASK BANK — exported from the live database, not authored here.
Nine tasks. Two of them (s01_vier_tage_woche, t01_sprachkurs_anfrage) also
have an INSERT in seed_b2.js; the other seven existed ONLY in one local
Postgres until this file. That included g04_homeoffice_thread, which the
writing loop demo runs on, and p01_aufnahmebericht_kremer, the only task a
teacher has ever marked.
Do NOT hand-edit. The content_points carry detector regexes the
content-point checker depends on; changing one by hand changes scoring.
Edit the database and re-export.
PROVENANCE OF THIS EXPORT: pulled through GET /api/b2/tasks, which returns
b2_tasks rows verbatim, because the shell running the export could not open
a socket to Postgres. Verified byte-identical to the API response by
checksum after writing. Two fields are therefore ABSENT rather than
invented, because that endpoint does not select them:
- b2_tasks.source        (the per-task provenance note)
- the rubric definition  (dimensions, scale_max, subtest_weight,
pass_mark, borderline_low/high)
`rubric` below carries only what the API exposes and is enough to re-link a
task to an existing rubric row. Re-run tools/export_b2_tasks.js against the
database to capture the missing fields.
`review` is 'unreviewed' on every task. No teacher sign-off is recorded for
any of this German. Exporting it did not review it.
